content.name: Siobhan Nguyen
content.title: Analytics Lead
content.summary: Analytics lead with 14 years in retail, private health insurance, water and energy retail. Head a team of five analysts and own the customer and hardship reporting a Queensland energy retailer relies on for regulator submissions. Previously built the leakage analytics program that helped a water utility cut non-revenue water by 9%.

experience.title: Analytics Lead
bullets: Manage five analysts and a $410,000 tooling budget, setting the analytics roadmap with the heads of customer, pricing and compliance.
Rebuilt hardship program reporting in Databricks and Power BI so regulator submissions now pass internal review on the first draft instead of the fourth.
Identified 3,600 customers on outdated tariffs through a plan-fit analysis; proactive switching lowered their average bill by $190 a year and reduced complaints.
Introduced a fortnightly analytics review where every new metric is signed off by its business owner, cutting rework requests by about a third.

experience.title: Senior Data Analyst
bullets: Led the leakage analytics program, combining district meter readings with pipe age data to rank 420 zones for repair and helping cut non-revenue water by 9%.
Forecast summer demand for 11 supply schemes using seasonal models, giving operations three weeks' extra notice of likely restrictions.
Replaced a vendor reporting contract with in-house dashboards, saving $160,000 a year.

experience.title: Data Analyst
bullets: Analysed hospital and extras claims for 210,000 members to support product pricing reviews each April.
Developed a lapse-risk score that let the retention team prioritise calls, lifting save rates on targeted members from 21% to 29%.
Standardised 35 monthly reports into a single SAS workflow, halving the time to month-end sign-off.

experience.title: Reporting Analyst
bullets: Produced weekly trading reports for 48 stores and presented results to the state operations meeting.
Built a stock-turn analysis that flagged slow lines across homewares, freeing $1.3 million in working capital after range cuts.
Trained 20 store managers to use self-serve sales reports, reducing ad hoc requests to the team.

achievements.title: Water efficiency recognition
achievements.detail: Brigalow Water internal innovation award (2021) for the leakage zone ranking model.

achievements.title: Mentor, women in data program
achievements.detail: Mentored four early-career analysts through a Brisbane-based volunteer mentoring program since 2020.
